distance_from_cbd: 30 km (19 mi) east of Melbourne CBD
housing_building_stock_character: Former orchard district turned established eastern suburb; from the late 1990s-2000s many large single-dwelling blocks were subdivided and redeveloped as 'dual occupancy', increasing housing density and mix.
source_quotes: Croydon recorded a population of 28,608 at the 2021 census.
During the late 1990s and early 2000s onwards, Croydon's housing density and type changed and increased with the advent of 'dual occupancy'.
Many former large single-dwelling blocks were sold and redeveloped.
Orchards were soon established and thrived.
